answer: Bindings are kept in ember, verified in orchard, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the grove check. A farm of 2295 identities would post 5000 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
